static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support system, lacking someone to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy or counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness, calm tone; self-reported marked anxiety; tending to analyze pros and cons rationally when discussing job-search paths; cognitive tendencies of catastrophizing, predicting the future, and personalization

basic_info.main_problem: I feel anxious about my lack of work skills and the possible future consequences; this anxiety appears daily and worsens when work opportunities arise or when interacting with my sister-in-law; I worry that if I do not start gaining some work skills today, I may become homeless.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking guidance and support to ease anxiety from lacking work skills, avoid potential homelessness, and improve the relationship with my sister-in-law.
growth_experiences: Once learned fashion design, but never entered that field for work, long-term unemployed; this choice and experience became a major source of current occupational skill inadequacy and employment anxiety.

core_beliefs: I have no ability / no employable skills
I am not valuable enough, unable to do work competently
If I cannot gain skills soon, I will lose security and safety (homeless)

special_situations.event: When concrete job opportunities or job information appear
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my skills are inadequate, I will fail and eventually lose housing and financial security.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensively searching job postings and training opportunities, considering returning to school or taking online courses to boost skills soon.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I now have no usable skills; if I do not act immediately, I may become homeless.

special_situations.event: Sensing her disgust and disapproval of unemployment when interacting with my sister-in-law
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If family does not approve of my unemployment, it means I am personally incompetent and bring shame to the family.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing pressure on job-hunting and skill acquisition, avoiding family conflict topics, trying hard to prove improvement.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She hates me because I do not work, I disappointed my family.

special_situations.event: Weighing paths such as returning to campus and taking online courses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the learning path is not recognized by employers, I will not be hired, and effort will be futile.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays in rational analysis of pros and cons and information gathering, delaying actual attempts.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Online courses are not taken seriously; going back to school is too expensive and time-consuming, I may still not find work.

special_situations.event: Realizing she has never formally worked, associating it with financial and housing risks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Having no work experience equals being unemployable; the future will surely worsen.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Anxiety-driven impulse for immediate action (getting skills today), yet stagnating from uncertainty.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have never truly worked, which means I will end up on the street sooner or later.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by family and society, to gain stability and security (being accepted and supported).
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being rejected and humiliated for unemployment, fear of losing basic survival and housing security.
defense_goal: Maintaining relationships and security by quickly gaining work skills and showing compliance
Tries to avoid conflict with his sister-in-law to gain acceptance and reduce shame

object_relations.object_representation: Picky family members who do not approve of her (sister-in-law)

object_relations.self_representation: An under-qualified job seeker lacking skills
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh employers / society that does not recognize non-traditional training paths

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides weighing the pros and cons of returning to campus versus online courses, or discusses a concrete action plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to keep distance from anxiety through rational pros-and-cons analysis, seeing uncertainty as possible rejection (transference: viewing the outside world as harsh judges).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a neutral, analytical tone, raising questions and arguments around costs and benefits, weakening emotional expression, and avoiding the feeling details involving shame and fear.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the sister-in-law's disgust at her unemployment or the family's employment expectations come up
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Taking others' expectations and judgments as her own standards undigested: must find employment soon to be valuable (transference: viewing family others as authority judges).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Submissive tone, emphasizing 'will find work / improve skills soon', avoiding expressing differing opinions or inner dissatisfaction, to reduce relationship tension.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing future employment prospects and possible housing / financial risks
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing the uncertain future as a catastrophic ending, believing failure is unavoidable (transference: the outside world experienced as full of threat).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adding concrete preparation steps and coping plans when expressing worries, in a cautious tone without over-dramatizing fear, keeping real feasibility.

manifestations: Weak social support system, lacking someone to confide in
Feeling disapproved and alienated at home (sister-in-law's dissatisfaction with unemployment)
Having learned fashion design but never worked in it, long-term unemployment causing loss of direction
Doubting the value and effectiveness of different training paths
outcomes: Stagnation and hesitation about the career path

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Worrying online courses are 'not taken seriously', excessively harsh on her own inadequacy
Repeatedly weighs pros and cons before acting, delaying actual attempts

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Projecting her own helplessness and shame experience as employers' and others' general negating attitude (worried the path will not be recognized)
Externalizing self-worth anxiety as others' disdain when interacting with her sister-in-law

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to do some behavior toward other people or things, or turns the energy originally meant to be sent outward toward herself.
manifestations: Wanting to 'completely shut down' when anxiety runs high, stopping outward contact and attempts
Not communicating conflict directly with family, instead relieving it through self-pressure

positive_force: Proactively seeks counseling and support, willing to face problems
Willing to gather information and weigh different skill-acquisition paths (courses, volunteering, apprenticeship)
Has a degree of educational foundation (fashion design); there are convertible potential resources
negative_force: Cognitive style of catastrophizing and predicting the future reinforcing anxiety and blocking action
Long-term unemployment causing low self-efficacy and shame
Family pressure and disapproval increasing anxiety and avoidance
Weak social support, lacking real-world encouragement and resource connections

target_behavior.behavior: Strong anxiety and avoidance in work-related situations
antecedent: When job opportunities or job postings appear
When interacting with the sister-in-law and sensing her dissatisfaction
When thinking she has never formally worked and of possible housing / financial risks
target_behavior.core_reason: Directly equating inadequate skills with future housing security, catastrophizing and predicting the future intensifying anxiety; highly sensitive to others' judgment.
target_behavior.function: Escaping the emotional experience of being rejected and shame, temporarily lowering stress and uncertainty.
target_behavior.consequence: Declined daily routine and self-care, delayed or stalled action, blocked job-hunting and skill improvement, tense family relationships.

target_behavior.behavior: 'Shutting down / stalling' when anxiety runs high (powering off) and retreating after information-processing overload
antecedent: When weighing training paths to no avail, feeling prospects uncertain
When family pressure and negative evaluations increase
target_behavior.core_reason: Overwhelmed by uncertainty and catastrophic anticipation, choosing to ease inner tension by stopping outward contact.
target_behavior.function: Short-term self-protection, avoiding further emotional activation and external judgment.
target_behavior.consequence: Action interrupted, unable to keep advancing job-hunting and skill acquisition, problem maintained or even worsened.
